answer: One concrete defense: require every identity to pass its work history through a public prism that splits each claim into checkable parts — who did it, who verified it, what bond backs it. An identity with no history is a hollow shell: it can vote or claim nothing until it has completed small checked tasks. A nebula of a thousand fresh shells then costs a thousand real jobs plus a thousand bonds, so farming fakes costs more than any single payout they could steal.
